How These Reports Are Written

  • Each report is written from current data when you run it: every figure comes from the loaded records or from ERPNext's own reports, and the report lists what it checked. Where the records do not hold something a report should cover, it says so rather than leaving it out.
  • Projections and recommendations are labelled as such. The board report is written on request only and is not released outside the company without an approval.
  • Any other report can be put on a schedule: it is written at that time and emailed as a PDF to the people you choose, who must have an account on this site, so a report never leaves the company. It is written with the permissions of the person who set the schedule.

Why these numbers probably understate the problem
    Where the job records themselves make the figures above less reliable than they look.
    What engineering earns
    What each project has billed against what it has cost. Parts issued, hours booked and purchases linked to a project add up to its cost; its invoices to what it earned.
    Warranty and repeat failures
    Warranty claims by product. Which models keep coming back, and for whom — the numbers that say whether a product line is worth selling.
    Maintenance we should be selling
    Service visits scheduled after an installation. Every installation should create the next service visit; recurring maintenance revenue is only asked for when it is scheduled.

Found in the records this morning: the open alerts and the checks an auditor runs first. Raise it opens a new Non Conformance in ERPNext with the finding filled in.
How a finding works
  • A finding is a Non Conformance in ERPNext: what was found, against which procedure, and the corrective and preventive action.
  • What will be done, by whom and by when is a Quality Action, one resolution per step, each with the person responsible and a completion date.
  • A finding is closed by setting it to Resolved; this screen counts what is still open and what is past its date.
  • A finding on a procedure that was found wanting before is counted as a repeat.

What this platform adds to it
  • Every change an administrator makes here — people, businesses, keys — is recorded with who and when, under Settings → Changes. A secret's value never is.
  • Every alert keeps who acknowledged, assigned, deferred or dismissed it, and the reason given.
  • Every action taken from this platform — an approval, a task handed out — is made in ERPNext under the manager's own account, so ERPNext's own history records it as theirs.
